testId: tests/admin/DashboardPage/DashboardTest.spec.ts > BMP-36 TC1: Admin is redirected to the Dashboard after login

scenario.summary: The project's Admin account (role Admin on qa) signs in on the storefront with username and password (standard login) and is redirected to the BI WORLDWIDE Web Admin Dashboard (/admin).
steps: Open the storefront sign-in page (config webstoreURL, /login)
Enter the Admin account's username and password (config adminUsername / adminPassword, from env ADMIN_USERNAME / ADMIN_PASSWORD) and sign in
Check that the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin) is shown
stateChanges: A session is started for the Admin account
assertions: After sign-in the Admin user is redirected to the Web Admin Dashboard (/admin)
evidence: Jira BMP-36 AC1 and test case TC1 (work/stories/BMP-36/input/BMP-36-story.md); no FRD
